markup.message: <lt-toast> is on a page in "nb", and writes its own text in "en": "Notifications", "Close message". A screen reader reads it out in the middle of the page's language. Write label, close-label in the page's language.

page.message: <lt-toast> is on a page in "nb", and writes its own text in "en": "Notifications", "Close message". A screen reader reads it out in the middle of the page's language. Write label, close-label in the page's language.

styled.message: <lt-toast> is on a page in "nb", and writes its own text in "en": "Notifications", "Close message". A screen reader reads it out in the middle of the page's language. Write label, close-label in the page's language.

<label> is on a page in "nb", and the stylesheet shows "(required)" after it, in "en", which a screen reader reads as part of the name. Set --lt-label-required-text in the page's language in a stylesheet of your own.
